target_state: Clean reconstruction of an unnamed vftable slot, staged in its own package. Four bytes, two instructions: LEA EAX,[ECX + 0x4] / RET. The body computes the receiver's address plus 0x4 and returns it; it performs no memory access, no transfer and no stack effect. The receiver convention is INFERRED from vftable slot membership (rule V1-VFT: 66 vptr-backed tables, caller cleanup, no stack-argument read), not observed in the body, which never dereferences ECX. The receiver is modelled as void* and no struct or member name is invented: the machine-derived receiver record is bounds_only with an empty offset set.

intended_paths.status: staging-only handoff; no canonical path is claimed

implementation.linkage: C language linkage (extern "C"), so the inline-assembly call site in the model test can name the symbol directly
implementation.calling_convention: __thiscall, receiver in ECX -- INFERRED, not observed. See observed_original_abi.convention_basis.
implementation.argument_surface: the receiver in ECX and nothing else. No ordinary stack argument, because the body never reads a stack slot and its terminator is a bare RET with no immediate; a thiscall declaration with one ordinary argument would compile to ret $4, which this body does not have.
implementation.return_type_note: The machine fact is one 32-bit word in EAX whose value is the receiver's address plus 0x4 (derived return record: register EAX, width 4, void_possible). void* is four bytes on this target and is the most literal spelling of an address computation's result; the width is what the machine evidence corroborates, and the exact C type spelling remains a source-side choice among the types of that width. No return_type is claimed in observed_original_abi for the same reason: the engine's own return.type is null.
implementation.receiver_model: opaque. Declared void*; the body never dereferences it (LEA takes its address without a memory access through it), and the machine-derived receiver record is bounds_only with an empty offset set. No struct is typedef'd and no member is named.
implementation.dispatch_model: none declared in the body. The function has no indirect transfer, so no slot boundary, index or dispatch table appears in pkg_vft_slot_006e64f0.cpp. The vtable membership is recorded in the header as observed data about the data segment, not as a model of the body.
implementation.extern_callees: none. dependencies.callees = [], the xref export records no outgoing edge of any reference type for this VA, and the machine dispatch record counts indirect_calls = 0. There is therefore no extern callee for the model test to define as an observer; that absence is part of what the test asserts, since a reconstruction that acquired a callee would need a symbol the test does not define and the link would fail.
implementation.compile_gate: clang++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -m32 on both translation units, ar qc + ranlib into a static archive, linked and run: clean, exit 0, all checks passed.
implementation.byte_identity_check: clang++ -std=c++17 -O2 -m32 -c pkg_vft_slot_006e64f0.cpp then objdump -d on the object emits, for re_006e64f0, exactly `8d 41 04  c3` -- the original four bytes of 0x006e64f0..0x006e64f3 in order, and nothing else. This is reported as a check, not as a claim that the model was written to match bytes: it is what the compiler produced from the declared convention and arity.

function_extent.raw_bytes_provenance: read_memory @ 0x006e64f0, 16 bytes: 8d 41 04 c3 cc cc cc cc cc cc cc cc cc cc. The trailing 0xcc is inter-function padding and belongs to no function body here. The bridge's /disassemble_function listing agrees instruction for instruction.

observed_original_abi.convention_basis: PLACEMENT, NOT OBSERVATION. The body never dereferences ECX -- the machine-derived ABI record's receiver evidence is 'ecx_address_taken_without_memory_access', because LEA takes the receiver's address without any memory access through it -- so the listing alone cannot name a receiver register. The derived record reaches __thiscall through rule V1-VFT: 0x006e64f0 is the value of a slot in 66 vptr-backed vftables (predicate P of tools/reconstruction_tooling/vftables.py, measured on this image), the callee pops nothing, no stack word is read as an argument, and no incoming EDX read exists -- so the receiver is in a register, and ECX is the only one that carries one. This package models the receiver for arity and flags the inference rather than presenting it as a reading of the body.
observed_original_abi.return_semantics: one 32-bit word in EAX, value receiver + 0x4; the engine's own classification is unclassified_in_EAX with void_possible, and the width route of the return-evidence module measures WIDTH_4_IN_EAX over the complete listing
observed_original_abi.ghidra_convention_note: Ghidra reports no calling convention (ghidra_calling_convention = null, parameter_count = 0): without a known convention the decompiler does not recognise ECX as a receiver. That silence is consistent with, not evidence for, the V1-VFT inference.
observed_original_abi.dispatch: the machine dispatch record counts indirect_calls = 0, call_offsets = [] and vtable_shaped_loads = 0, which agrees with a listing containing no transfer at all
observed_original_abi.evidence_level: ABI_INFERRED (derived record: ABI_INFERRED via V1-VFT, confidence INFERRED; the listing-derived receiver evidence abstains)

mechanics.body_shape: one address computation into the return register, then the function's single exit. No prologue, no epilogue, no saved register, no stack adjustment, no frame.
mechanics.transfers: none. No CALL, no JMP, no computed transfer, no indirect transfer through a register or a memory operand. The complete 2-instruction listing and the xref export (no outgoing edge of any reference type) agree on zero outgoing transfers.
mechanics.memory: no memory access of any kind in the complete 2-instruction listing. LEA computes an address; it does not read or write the bytes at it. Therefore no displacement is read and none is written, no field is accessed through any register, and no data-segment address is named. This is what the FIELDS/OFFSETS and GLOBALS checks read, and it is the direct test for in the model test (poisoned receiver snapshot, plus a receiver on a PROT_NONE page).
mechanics.control_flow: none. The complete listing contains no conditional branch, so the body is straight-line with exactly one path and one exit. There is no input that selects a different outcome.
mechanics.stack: the RET carries no immediate and no stack slot is ever read, so zero ordinary stack arguments, zero bytes of callee cleanup, caller owns the stack. Checked behaviourally: the model test pushes a canary before the raw call and requires it to be intact on return.
mechanics.return_word: EAX holds the receiver's address plus 0x4. The LEA is a 3-byte address computation with an 8-bit displacement, so the return register word is exactly ECX + 0x4 for every receiver.
mechanics.globals: none. The complete 2-instruction listing names no data-segment address. The record's globals entry says the same.

vtable_placement.bound_below_by: the dword at 0x013fae9c is 0x00000000 (read_memory @ 0x013faea0, 64 bytes, and @ 0x013fae90, 16 bytes)
vtable_placement.extent_claim: none. Only the sixteen words actually read are recorded. The image's true end is not established here, and no claim about the other 65 tables is made beyond their count.
vtable_placement.use: recorded in the header as observed data about the data segment, and asserted in the model test. It is not used in the body: the body has no indirect transfer and performs no dispatch.

return_semantics.kind: receiver address plus a fixed displacement in EAX
return_semantics.value: ECX + 0x4. Unconditional, the same computation for every receiver, on the only path the body has.
return_semantics.ownership: Not applicable and not claimed. The body computes an address; it acquires, releases and stores nothing.
return_semantics.lifetime: The value is an address into the receiver's storage. Whether it is a member, a byte past the vptr, or something else is not established by two instructions that never dereference it, and no claim is made.

unresolved_questions: What the returned address denotes. The body computes receiver + 0x4 and returns it; whether that address is a member, a byte past the vptr, or something else is not established by two instructions that never dereference it.
The receiver's class. V1-VFT proves the function is a virtual member of some class; with no MSVC RTTI in this binary and a bounds_only receiver record, no class name and no layout are claimed.
The extent of the vftable images. Only the first table's sixteen words were read; the other 65 memberships are counted, not transcribed.

conditions: A trace of the original process reaches this slot through a receiver in ECX and captures EAX at 0x006e64f3.
The capture shows EAX equal to the receiver's address plus 0x4.
